svg.aria-label: Three epistemic tiers: exact mathematics, domain diagnostic, speculative interpretation
svg.title: Epistemic tiers
svg.desc: Tier 1 exact mathematics, Tier 2 domain diagnostic, Tier 3 speculative interpretation, with what each requires and where the present note stands.
svg.text: Tier 1 — Exact mathematics
h = a/b ⟺ a = b³ ⟺ b³ + b − 1 = 0; uniqueness; sign law
coordinate transformations; Fisher metric; C(1 + C)² = 1 under a declared embedding
True and checkable. Explanatory of nothing by itself.
Tier 2 — Domain diagnostic
independently motivated sectors, with a reason they close
derived embedding a/b = F(X), conventional parts separated
declared normalization; physical admissibility of the landmark
a test that could fail: held-out prediction, family collapse with residual,
independent determination, or compression
Tier 3 — Speculative interpretation
universal-mechanism claims; the cubic as fundamental
shared geometry read as shared dynamics
sharp physical onset unsupported by domain physics
Statable only when labelled. Requires Tier-2 evidence first.
exact
testable
conjectural
Nothing in the synthesis note reaches Tier 2.
